title: "About"
---

I am a graduate student in the Department of Statistics at the University of British Columbia, Vancouver. I did my undergrad in Statistics, with a minor in Linguistics, at the Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur.

I am currently working on Markov chain sampling and Monte Carlo integration with [Dr Trevor Campbell](https://trevorcampbell.me/) and [Dr Alexandre Bouchard-Côté](https://www.stat.ubc.ca/~bouchard/).
